profile.summary: Started off with full-stack development, my focus has shifted to the backend of things. I not only enjoy being a code monkey, but also the challenges of making disparate systems work together.

positions.title: Principal System Developer
positions.description:
1 man development team maintaining the SOAP/REST APIs that the entire company uses to access/maintain critical business data, amidst several other web-based internal applications. Ported applications run natively on IBM partitions to run in Containers with full network DB2 access without an IBM Connect server. This included updating codebases to work under PHP 7.4 to allow refactoring from ZF 1.12 to Laminas.

Your normal "Jack of all Trades" cornucopia of skills; systems development, general server administration (no PTFs), technology training, writing automated testing systems and comprehensive system documentation sure to satisfy any after-hours support folks.

IBM for i 7.3 & 7.4, DB2 for i, PHP 5.6+, PHP 7.4+, JavaScript, Zend Server 8.5, Apache 2.4, Docker, Microsoft Azure (APIM), ARCAD, Git, Bash, Qsh
